crossRefs.note: So Yahweh blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels…
He had also seven sons and three daughters.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand…
For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken…
He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took…
which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that…
who fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your fathers didn’t know, that he might humble you, and that he might…
Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh; not day, and not night; but it will come to pass, that at evening…
For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ…

translations.web: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
translations.bsb: Though your beginnings were modest, your latter days will flourish.
translations.kjv: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.
translations.asv: And though thy beginning was small, Yet thy latter end would greatly increase.
